scope: Primary-source review; original local scenarios only. No upstream tasks, dependencies or reported benchmark scores imported.

sources.title: INFUSE: A Unified Surface Benchmark for Indirect Prompt Injection in Agentic Systems
sources.reason: Add original tool-returned workflow-file instructions and transient tool-error recovery attacks with matched benign controls. This small support-agent pilot does not reproduce long-horizon shell workflows or upstream tasks.

sources.title: MCP-SafetyBench
sources.reason: Measure actual agent tool actions across untrusted MCP-like descriptions and results; defer the real-service suite and unverified reuse rights.

sources.title: Agent Security Bench (ASB)
sources.reason: Add retrieved-memory authority spoofing with task-utility controls; full mixed-attack and backdoor environments remain future work.

sources.title: Agent-SafetyBench
sources.reason: Broad interactive environments are relevant; importing its scorer model and environment dependencies requires a separate bounded integration.

sources.title: SHADE-Arena
sources.reason: Check hidden extra tool actions even when the legitimate task appears complete. Our small original scenario does not reproduce the private benchmark or evaluate a monitor.

sources.title: AgentDojo
sources.reason: Existing Scanner adapter already covers AgentDojo; retain separate attacker success and legitimate-task completion in the new pilot.

sources.title: InjecAgent
sources.reason: Existing pinned pilot records and inert attacker recorder already cover indirect injection; avoid copying another selected subset.

sources.title: ToolSandbox
sources.reason: Require a completed prior read before the summary write; defer installation of the upstream host-executing environment and its separate component terms.

sources.title: tau-bench / tau2-bench
sources.reason: Current upstream documentation adds multilingual text, full-duplex voice and entity intake. Scanner already pins tau2; task/version and audio-surface comparison is needed before changing the pin.

sources.title: AgentHarm
sources.reason: Scanner already has source-inspired report-only cases and an explicit license/runtime-review boundary. No additional upstream material is copied.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026
sources.reason: Use as a threat-category cross-check, including tool misuse and peer-authority abuse. It is not a runnable certification test suite.

sources.title: OWASP GenAI Red Teaming Manual 1.0
sources.reason: Use explicit scope, reproducible evidence and measured outcomes in the pilot receipt and review.

sources.title: OWASP Agent Control Standard
sources.reason: Middleware hooks may improve runtime evidence capture; actual platform/version support must be established before claiming conformance.

sources.title: MCP Security Best Practices
sources.reason: Add an original forged-consent receipt in a tool result and observe that it cannot authorize a private read. Token audience/passthrough, OAuth consent, state-handle hijacking and SSRF still require real host/server protocol tests; this pilot proves none of those protocol controls.

sources.title: Inspect AI
sources.reason: Already integrated/pinned. Useful for future native MCP/agent runs; no dependency upgrade is required for this pilot.

sources.title: Microsoft PyRIT
sources.reason: Existing framework route can host future adaptive attack experiments. No duplicate engine or unbounded attack-generation job is added.

sources.title: NVIDIA garak
sources.reason: Scanner already has the probe route. Static/adaptive model probes do not replace action-level authorization evidence.

sources.title: Promptfoo MCP red-team plugin
sources.reason: Add an original authorized-tool/wrong-parameter attack plus benign control using the existing inert action ledger. Keep the library pin; no remote Promptfoo generation, new dependency or native MCP plugin execution is enabled.
